title: MAPseq Sample Processing Protocol
author: Huiqing Zhan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bsm9nc96

steps.title: Tissue Collection and RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Dissect fresh frozen brain areas of interest and store in RNAse-free tubes at -80°C. Homogenize tissues in 400µl of Trizol using a Pellet Pestle Motor or tissue homogenizer, then add 600µl of Trizol to reach a total of 1ml Trizol per sample. Extract RNA following the Trizol Reagent manufacturer's protocol and dissolve the resulting RNA of each tissue sample into 13µl of H2O.

steps.title: Prepare First Strand Synthesis Reaction
steps.instruction: For each sample, combine the following reagents in a well for a total volume of 13µl: 4µl RNA sample, 6µl H2O, 1µl spike-in RNA, 1µl 10µM RT primer, and 1µl 10mM dNTP. Mix well.

steps.title: First Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Perform the reverse transcription reaction using the following thermal profile and additions:

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 70°C for 10 minutes, then immediately transfer to ice and incubate for 5 minutes.
Add 7µl of reagents per well: 4µl SSIV buffer, 1µl 0.1M DTT, 1µl RNasin, and 1µl SSIV. Mix well.
Incubate in a thermocycler for 10 minutes at 55°C and 10 minutes at 80°C.
Store samples at 4°C or -20°C until the next step.

steps.title: Pool and Purify RT Products
steps.instruction: Pool RT products from targets or injection sites separately (do not mix target and injection sites) and mix well. Purify using AMPure XP beads as follows:

substeps.instruction: Add 1.8X AMPure XP beads, mix by pipetting 10 times, and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Aliquot into several tubes for easier elution.
Place on a magnetic rack for 2-3 minutes until the solution is clear, then discard the supernatant.
Wash the pellet twice with fresh 80% EtOH for 30 seconds each.
Air dry the pellet.
Resuspend beads in H2O: use (17 * (total number of target site/10) µl) for target sites, or (17 * (total number of target site/5) µl) for injection sites.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, then collect all supernatant in an Eppendorf tube using a magnetic rack.

steps.title: Second Strand Synthesis
steps.instruction: For every 17µl of bead-purified product, prepare the second strand reaction and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.4µl SSIV buffer, 0.6µl 0.1M DTT, 5.6µl Second Strand buffer, 0.75µl 10mM dNTPs, 0.25µl E coli DNA ligase, 1µl DNA polymerase I, and 0.25µl RNaseH. Mix well.
Incubate in a thermocycler for 2 hours at 16°C.
Add 1µl of T4 DNA polymerase and incubate for 10 minutes at 16°C.
Store samples at 4°C or -20°C until the next step.

steps.title: Pool and Purify Second Strand Products
steps.instruction: Pool all second stranding reactions and measure total volume. Purify using AMPure XP beads:

substeps.instruction: Add 1.8x AMPure XP beads, mix by pipetting 10 times, and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Place on a magnetic rack for 2-3 minutes until clear, then discard supernatant.
Wash the pellet twice with fresh 80% EtOH for 30 seconds each.
Air dry the pellet.
Resuspend beads in (16 * (total number of 2nd strand reaction) µl) of H2O.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, then collect all supernatant in a PCR tube using a magnetic rack.

steps.title: Exonuclease Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the purified product with Exonuclease I to remove primers.

substeps.instruction: Per 16µl of bead-purified product, add 2µl Exonuclease buffer and 2µl Exo I. Mix well.
Incubate in a thermocycler for 1 hour at 37°C.
Heat inactivate at 80°C for 20 minutes.
Store samples at 4°C or -20°C until the next step.

steps.title: PCR I Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform the first round of PCR amplification.

substeps.instruction: Per 20µl Exonuclease reaction, add 25µl Accuprime buffer, 25µl 10µM nested1st gfpF primer, 25µl 10µM nested2nd primer, 2.5µl Accuprime Pfx HF enzyme, and 152.5µl H2O. Mix well and aliquot into PCR tubes.
Run thermal cycling: Initial denaturation at 95°C (2 min); 15 cycles of 95°C (15 sec) and 68°C (2.5 min); Final extension at 68°C (5 min).
Add 5µl of Exo I to each 50µl PCR reaction.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes, then heat inactivate at 80°C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: PCR II Optimization
steps.instruction: Determine the optimal cycle number for the second PCR round.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 25µl test reaction: 2.5µl 1/10 diluted PCR I product, 2.5µl Accuprime buffer, 2.5µl 10µM Sol I primer, 2.5µl 10µM Sol II primer, 0.25µl Accuprime Pfx HF enzyme, and 14.75µl H2O.
Run different cycle numbers: 14, 17, 20, 23, 26, and 29 for pooled target sites; 11, 14, 17, 20, and 23 for pooled injection sites.
Thermal cycling: Initial denaturation at 95°C (2 min); cycles of 95°C (15 sec) and 68°C (1 min); Final extension at 68°C (5 min).
Load products on a 2% agarose gel to identify the lowest cycle number producing a single, clean 230bp band.

steps.title: Final PCR II Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform the final PCR II amplification using the optimal cycle number.

substeps.instruction: Prepare reactions: For pooled injection sites, use 12ml of PCR II reaction; for pooled target sites, use 3ml for 40 samples.
In each reaction, add: PCR I product (same concentration as test PCR II), 1x Accuprime buffer, 1µM Sol I primer, 1µM Sol II primer, and 1U Accuprime Pfx HF enzyme per 50µl of reaction.
Run thermal cycling: Initial denaturation at 95°C (2 min); optimal cycles of 95°C (15 sec) and 68°C (2.5 min); Final extension at 68°C (5 min).

steps.title: PCR Product Purification and Validation
steps.instruction: Purify and validate the 230bp PCR product.

substeps.instruction: Purify PCR product using Wizard® SV Gel and PCR Clean-Up System (Promega), eluting into 40µl H2O per 1ml of PCR product.
Load purified product into a 2% agarose gel.
Cut the ~230bp band from the gel and purify using the MinElute Gel Extraction Kit (Qiagen).
Load purified 230bp product on a DNA bioanalyzer chip using Agilent High Sensitivity DNA Kit to confirm size and quantity.

steps.title: Sequencing
steps.instruction: Submit the purified 230bp product for an Illumina NextSeq500 high output run (paired end 36) using SBS3T sequencing primer for paired end 1 and Illumina small RNA sequencing primer 2 for paired end 2.
